name: Hawa Engineers Limited
about: Hawa Engineers Limited manufactures and sells industrial valves primarily in India. It offers gate, globe, check, API, forged steel, ball, and butterfly valves, strainers, air, diaphragm, plug, control, steam traps, and safety valves. The company also offers screwed gate, globe, NRV, gun metal/bronze, polypropylene, needle, pulp, and flush bottom tank/ball valve; SDNR, and FEP/PFA lined valve; and sight glass; and pneumatic valves and accessories. In addition, its products are used in various industries comprising steel, power generation, refinery/petro chemicals, water treatment, fertilizer, pharma, pulp, paper, sugar, pharma, drugs, cement, OEM, contractors, and chemical industries. Further, the company sells products under the MARCK brand through a network of dealers, suppliers, and associates. Additionally, it exports products to Dubai. Hawa Engineers Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
